intake_binding: Every emitted packet must bind field-exactly to one frozen intake packet of ORION.A6.ExternalAuthorityPacketIntakeManifest.v1 (stratum, split, lineage trio, version ids, transition digests, all three receipts, candidate_visible_packet_sha256). The validator is authoritative: if a filled packet is rejected, fix the packet, never the validator.
template_usage: Exactly one gold packet per frozen intake packet (60 primary + replication intake packets). Replace every null with a concrete value; keep the fixed false flags false. Both gold labels are adjudicated separately over the terminal alphabet ADMIT/DENY/CANNOT_CHECK. Unadjudicated intake packets are reported by the validator and never filled in by ORION.
escrow_statement: The two gold labels are escrowed gold. ORION never authors, infers, or commits targets. Completed packets are held outside ORION until candidate and baseline predictions are durably frozen; only then are they released as the gold side of the evaluation. Governance sign-off is external continuation, never promotion.
adjudication_must_precede: adjudicator_receipt.adjudication_started_before_prediction_reveal must be true and honest: adjudication starts before any ORION-side candidate or baseline prediction exists.
disagreement_rule: Per label: if disagreement_observed is true, either a non-empty resolution is required or the target must be CANNOT_CHECK (unresolved authority is CANNOT_CHECK). If disagreement_observed is false, resolution must be null/empty. Notes are always required.

field_guidance.packet_id: Exactly the frozen intake packet_id this packet adjudicates.
field_guidance.stratum/split/lineage/version/digest/rec: Copied verbatim from the frozen intake packet; the validator enforces field-exact equality against the intake manifest.
field_guidance.labels.local_action_release_authority.ta: Exactly one of: ADMIT, DENY, CANNOT_CHECK.
field_guidance.labels.scientific_discharge_admission_au: Exactly one of: ADMIT, DENY, CANNOT_CHECK; adjudicated independently of the first label.
field_guidance.labels.*.rationale: Non-empty human-readable justification citing the transition's target-relevant scientific coordinates.
field_guidance.labels.*.evidence_refs: Non-empty list of non-empty references (source URLs, registry records, metadata fields, or content digests inspected).
field_guidance.labels.*.disagreement_record.disagreemen: Explicit boolean; true if any adjudicator disagreement occurred.
field_guidance.labels.*.disagreement_record.resolution: null/empty when no disagreement; non-empty resolution when disagreement was observed and resolved; unresolved disagreement forces target CANNOT_CHECK.
field_guidance.labels.*.disagreement_record.notes: Always required, non-empty: how adjudication was performed, who was involved, what was checked.
field_guidance.adjudicator_receipt.adjudicator_id: Stable identifier of the external adjudicator (person or role) authoring the packet.
field_guidance.adjudicator_receipt.adjudicated_at_utc: UTC timestamp string of adjudication completion (e.g. 2026-09-10T14:03:00Z).
field_guidance.adjudicator_receipt.receipt_sha256: SHA-256 (hex, 64 lowercase) over the canonical packet body (the adjudicator's own receipt hash, excluding the receipt_sha256 field).
field_guidance.adjudicator_receipt.independence_atteste: Must be true: attests independence from ORION-side prediction and outcome custody.

prepared_by_this_template: Per-packet adjudication prep files (candidate-visible payload + bound fields + EMPTY sign-off slots) are prepared inside ORION under adjudication-prep-v1/; the sign-off slots stay null and confer nothing.
